title: Pitagna mod reborn
description: an open-source version of Pitagna mod that has updates and diverges from the original
body: A new version of pitagna mod, the pitagna ingot is replace by pitagna gem. when you craft it you win one pitagna gem power in 0.0.2 you can use 15 pitagna gem power to enable fly.You can craft pitagna gem with quartz, emerald and iron ingot. GOOD LUCK
